explanation: Do not cache get_user results for the life of a process: a cached user could retain roles after those roles are revoked. Issue #640 tracks this hazard.
After db.Query(q), check err before calling defer rows.Close(). If the query fails, rows is nil, so trying to close it would fail.
The setTimeout call delays measure(el) until layout has settled. Replacing it with queueMicrotask would run the measurement too early.
Never log the contents of the token, whose type is Secret<String>. Its Debug output is redacted, so debugging output must not expose the underlying secret.
RetryCount and the Http.Retry setting in appsettings.json must be updated together so the two retry settings stay consistent. appsettings.json is the configuration file; Http.Retry is the setting.
Before passing offset to ch.map, ensure it is divisible by pageSize with no remainder. The memory mapping rejects an unaligned offset.
The trailing slash in build/ makes rsync copy the contents of the build directory into DEST, rather than copying the build directory itself. DEST is the destination variable.
The BRIN index on created_at is chosen because this table is appended in time order; the comment says it uses about 1% of the space of a btree index. created_at is the indexed column.
Replace this loop that spins while flag is set with a futex-based wait. The task is done when lock_acquire in src/sync/lock.c sleeps instead of spinning.

The failover section of the runbook, referenced by doc:runbook#failover, explains why dbo.RebuildStats runs on the secondary. dbo.RebuildStats is the procedure declared here; the comment does not state the reason itself.
The upstream proxy ends idle requests after 60 seconds, so this request timeout must stay below 60 seconds. The current value is 30 seconds.
Keep Widget's destructor virtual. Making ~Widget() non-virtual could prevent derived-class destructors from running when an object is deleted through a Widget pointer. Issue #915 tracks this hazard.
Run PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON on each SQLite connection before any writes on that connection, because the setting is connection-specific.

Keep Name as a fixed-length ShortString, written here as string[40], because the containing record is written directly to disk byte for byte. Changing it to string would change that stored representation.
p_id is caller input, so pass it through the :1 bind variable in EXECUTE IMMEDIATE. Concatenating it into the SQL text could allow SQL injection.
